They still need per-map assignment, partial-reveal tests, actor/trail contrast checks on small screens, any requested image-tool refinements and explicit content packaging. The harbor has invented leaf emblems on cargo; these are not Coupa marks or a claimed Navi likeness. Ukrainian motifs and invented settlements are documented as interpretations rather than exact historical reconstructions. Static illustrations contain no independently animated objects.
